definition.name: Create Floors From Polygons
definition.description: Creates a single-layer concrete floor type and places floors on a level from mm polygon lists.
definition.aiDescription: Creates a single-layer concrete floor type and places floors on a level from mm polygon lists.
examples: Create a 200 mm concrete floor type (BC_Slab 200mm) and place the Block C Level 2 slab (light wells left open) plus 8 balcony slabs.
